items.title: Unconventional quantum materials could dramatically boost the search for dark matter
items.summary: For decades, physicists have searched for dark matter, the invisible substance thought to make up roughly 85% of all matter in the universe. Although its gravitational influence shapes galaxies and the large-scale structure of the cosmos, dark matter has never been directly detected. items.title: 雪落冰城，上行有速：中国联通携手华为部署5G-A大上行网络，赋能冰城新体验
items.summary: 近日，中国联通黑龙江分公司携手华为，在冰城哈尔滨市打造5G-A大上行示范区，创新落地1.8GHz与2.1GHz双频8T8R方案，实现网络上行能力全面升级——在单用户上行峰值突破1Gbps基础上，依托8T8R多天线优势，实现示范区内上行覆盖提升10.8dB，上行20Mbps体验满足度超90%，较部署前提升30个百分点，显著改善热点场景上行业务体验。黑龙江文旅产业特色鲜明，每年冬季旅游旺季吸引大量游客，催生视频分享、实时直播等上行密集型业务。此次示范区的建设，将为冰城冰雪旅游季提供坚实网络保障。中国联通将全方位赋能冰城冰雪文旅新业态，以数智技术将得天独厚的“冷资源”转化为文旅发展的“热活力”，为东北振兴筑牢坚实的数字通信底座。

As quantum computers have grown more powerful, researchers have devised increasingly sophisticated ways to test whether these machines are truly harnessing quantum effects—but every method so far has run into limits.

items.title: Superfluid qubit could help scale up quantum computers
items.summary: Superfluid helium could offer a new way to tackle one of the biggest challenges in scaling up quantum computers, say researchers from the University of Surrey. The research team has introduced a conceptual design for a new type of qubit that could be much less vulnerable to errors.

items.title: Plasma mirror self-focusing boosts gamma-ray generation
items.summary: Nature Photonics, Published online: 28 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-01993-1 One approach to generate high-energy X-rays and γ-rays is inverse Compton scattering, where a high-energy electron beam collides with an intense laser pulse. However, this process is notoriously difficult because the electron and laser beams must be precisely aligned in space and time. Now, a coated plasma mirror is shown to dramatically increase the efficiency and energy of the generation.
